# Security and Reliability Requirements Checklist: LLM Provider Gateway

**Purpose**: Review whether the LLM Provider requirements are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and measurable for secrets, untrusted model data, paid network calls, failure recovery, and concurrency.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are credential acquisition, lifetime, rotation, isolation, and non-persistence requirements all documented, including missing-secret behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK002 Are all data surfaces that must exclude secrets and sensitive prompts enumerated consistently across results, errors, events, logs, configuration, repr, and test artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013/FR-015/FR-019]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for every supported message role, content modality, Tool Call form, Structured Output result, Usage field, and terminal state? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003–FR-006/FR-014]
- [x] CHK004 Are retry, Fallback, timeout, cancellation, rate-limit, and circuit-breaker requirements defined for both non-streaming and streaming calls? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-012]
- [x] CHK005 Are online smoke-test safety requirements complete for opt-in control, account isolation, request/output limits, timeout, logging, and missing credentials? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “Provider original body” distinguished clearly from safe provider request IDs and allowlisted diagnostic metadata? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK007 Is the boundary between a user-visible stream delta and non-visible Usage metadata explicit enough to determine when retry/Fallback becomes forbidden? [Clarity, Spec User Story 3; Plan §Design Decisions 2]
- [x] CHK008 Are “retryable”, “Fallback allowed”, “temporary failure”, and “unknown failure” mapped to an exhaustive stable error taxonomy without subjective interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010/FR-011/FR-013]
- [x] CHK009 Are capability compatibility rules explicit for Tool Calling, Structured Output, modality, context capacity, output capacity, and Usage availability? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007/FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Is the meaning of unknown Token or monetary Usage distinguished from zero Usage and partial aggregate Usage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014; Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are Pydantic-based final validation requirements consistent with the prohibition on Pydantic and Provider types entering platform/domain contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-006; Plan §Design Decisions 3]
- [x] CHK012 Do Tool Calling requirements consistently prohibit Tool execution and Provider built-in tools while still allowing schema description and returned Tool Calls? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005/FR-020; Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Are the total timeout, per-attempt timeout, first-block timeout, idle timeout, retry backoff, and Fallback budgets ordered consistently so no requirement permits work after the total deadline? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009/FR-010]
- [x] CHK014 Are per-call isolation requirements consistent with intentionally shared `(provider, model)` rate-limit and circuit-breaker state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK015 Are the declared two-provider scope and extension criterion consistent, without implying runtime discovery or support for unverified OpenAI-compatible endpoints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002/SC-010; Assumptions]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are requirements present for cancellation during rate-limit wait, retry backoff, credential resolution, first-block wait, active streaming, and terminal assembly? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are partial and malformed stream cases covered, including half a Tool Call argument, missing terminal metadata, duplicate IDs, unknown finish reasons, and a provider stream that never yields? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are concurrency requirements defined for different credentials, tenants, models, Provider adapters, half-open probes, and cancellation without cross-request state leakage? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018; Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a Provider that reports success with empty content, reasoning-only content, invalid Structured Output, or unknown proprietary content blocks? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006/FR-019; Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are recovery requirements explicit when a circuit opens, a half-open probe succeeds or fails, or all compatible Fallback targets are unavailable? [Recovery Coverage, Spec §FR-011/FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Can the zero-secret-leakage criterion be objectively evaluated over every named observable surface using controlled sentinel values? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK022 Does the 1,000-call concurrency criterion define what constitutes state crossover and which target/credential combinations must be represented? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK023 Does the 10,000-call latency criterion define what network/provider waiting is excluded and how p95 is calculated without conflating Fake Provider latency? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK024 Do the contract and error-matrix success criteria identify a finite authoritative fixture set for both providers and all required behavior classes? [Traceability, Spec §SC-001/SC-003]
- [x] CHK025 Can the “new Provider without modifying existing adapters/contracts” criterion be assessed through a concrete extension seam rather than subjective code review? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Are Provider SDK/LangChain version, maintenance, license, Python compatibility, hidden retry behavior, and upgrade-contract assumptions documented? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context; Research §Decision 1/4]
- [x] CHK027 Is the assumption that capability profiles are curated configuration—not online discovery—stated consistently with ownership and stale-profile failure behavior? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions; Plan §Design Decisions 4]
- [x] CHK028 Is the non-persistent, per-process nature of rate-limit and circuit-breaker state explicit so readers do not infer distributed quota enforcement? [Scope, Plan §Design Decisions 6]
- [x] CHK029 Are excluded integrations—Runtime persistence, API/SSE, Graph, Context Engine, Langfuse, Tool Policy, and console—listed consistently across spec, plan, and contracts? [Scope Consistency, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK030 Is rollback scope documented as dependency/assembly reversal with no data migration, while preserving any platform contract already consumed by later features? [Recovery, Plan §Failure, Rollback, and Operations]
